I replied to Tobias in our DM to confirm the change: his standing call with the Marrow Fieldworks team for the Tamarack rollout is now Thursdays at 9:30.

I told him I don't have a separate memory store, so that DM is the only record of it. I also offered to add it to his calendar as a recurring event if he asks. Since he said no action was needed, I didn't create the event or tell anyone else.
